grinder.invalidation: Same as decision-level invalidation: material reduction in cross-seat conflict count on the intended instrument, or a forward move in SR3/SOFR spread that makes a defined small SOFR or CORRA expression clearly superior to 3.85% ACT/360 cash on a risk-adjusted basis.
grinder.label: Grinder
grinder.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
grinder.rationale: Empty book with zero calibration history and a preservation mandate favors earning SOFR on unused cash rather than forcing risk after a greater-than-90%-priced hike has already printed into US front ends at extreme percentiles. SR3 path context (4.32 / 4.58 / 4.755) informs forward policy disagreement only; realized funding remains SOFR 3.85%, so any new gross must clear that carry plus friction without relying on unstated marks. Actionable seats collide on AONIA direction, USD/CAD/NZD/AUD crosses, and simultaneous Canada STIR receive versus CA-US sovereign RV and US pay-SOFR views, while vol-convexity requires options that are unavailable this freeze. no-trade-skeptic (highest seat confidence) argues none of the thirteen pitches clears the hurdle versus cash; I accept that for grinder sizing until conflicts compress or a single rates-first expression dominates with a small, de-riskable line.
grinder.thesis: Hold the full mandate in SOFR-accruing unused cash rather than deploy gross into contested Canada/Australia/US STIR and FX expressions immediately after the Sep-16 hike transmission.

positions.invalidation: CORRA_2027-06 implied revisits or holds above the frozen 2028-09 peak area, or front CORRA meetings keep pricing additional hikes as data validate energy pass-through into generalized overheating.
positions.thesis: Receive 2027-06 CORRA: overnight CORRA remains low versus a priced 2027 hiking cycle that post-FOMC CAD STIR catch-up has overbuilt relative to Canadian labor 38 and core near 2%.

pragmatist.rationale: Empty book earns official SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 (2026-09-17) on unused cash; deploying modest rates risk is justified where the priced Canada path overshoots fundamentals and multiple handoff seats (rate-dove, perma-bear, positioning-cynic) align on receive CORRA rather than fighting the split AONIA camp or NZ FX with missing NZ rates. Reject no-trade-skeptic flat-only on hurdle grounds because the Canada policy-path gap is a defined macro expression, not a re-trade of the >90% priced Fed hike. Reject vol-convexity (options unavailable), catalyst-junkie vs mean-reverter AONIA conflict, and hawk SOFR pay as the primary leg to avoid doubling US duration risk without a single locked US-CA STIR combo. Accept rate-dove CORRA_2027-06 as the cleanest paper-markable rates-first ticket; dollar-king USDCAD is consistent FX color but secondary to the STIR edge. On-demand fallback and CFTC gaps cap conviction, not direction.
pragmatist.thesis: Receive 2027-06 CORRA: overnight CORRA remains low versus a priced 2027 hiking cycle that post-FOMC CAD STIR catch-up has overbuilt relative to Canadian labor 38 and core near 2%.

positions.invalidation: SOFR_2027-09 implied re-prices toward or below the SR3H7 6m forward anchor with US data rolling over enough to sustain the 2028 fade.
positions.thesis: Pay Sep-2027 SOFR futures: post-hike overnight at 3.85% leaves the SR3U7 terminal underpriced relative to still-hot US policy gauges.

swinger.rationale: Empty book with full $1bn unused cash earns official NY Fed SOFR 3.85% ACT/360 (2026-09-17); SR3 4.32/4.58/4.755 is forward context only and shows the market still embedding additional US tightening versus that cash hurdle. rate-hawk and trend-follower handoffs align on SOFR_2027-09 as the clean rates-first expression after the hike; no-trade-skeptic and cross-seat AONIA/NZD conflicts argue for selectivity, not diffusion. Deploying ~90% gross into a single SR3U7 pay accepts mark-to-market risk versus ~385bp annualized cash, but path repricing toward a higher terminal over a 1–6 month horizon is the only clustered edge that clears the post-hike funding reset without options, without NZ-rate gaps, and without opposing Canada/Australia STIR bets.
swinger.thesis: Pay Sep-2027 SOFR futures: post-hike overnight at 3.85% leaves the SR3U7 terminal underpriced relative to still-hot US policy gauges.
